description: This file implements the core logic for processing incoming synchronization messages related to shared channels in Mattermost, including user, post, reaction, acknowledgement, and status synchronization, as well as mention transformation.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Main service class handling synchronization logic for shared channels.

methods.name: onReceiveSyncMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming sync messages, validates topic and payload, and processes the message.

methods.name: processGlobalUserSync
methods.description: Processes synchronization of global users from remote clusters.

methods.name: processSyncMessage
methods.description: Main method to process sync messages, including user, post, reaction, acknowledgement, and membership changes.

methods.name: upsertSyncUser
methods.description: Creates or updates a user based on sync data, ensuring remote ID consistency.

methods.name: insertSyncUser
methods.description: Inserts a new user with remote sync considerations, handling username collisions.

methods.name: updateSyncUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user, handling conflicts and remote ID validation.

methods.name: upsertSyncPost
methods.description: Creates or updates a post, including handling deletions and metadata updates.

methods.name: syncRemotePriorityMetadata
methods.description: Replaces existing post priority metadata with remote data.

methods.name: syncRemoteAcknowledgementsMetadata
methods.description: Replaces all acknowledgements for a post with remote data.

methods.name: upsertSyncReaction
methods.description: Creates or deletes reactions based on remote data, validating post channel.

methods.name: upsertSyncAcknowledgement
methods.description: Creates or deletes acknowledgements, validating post channel.

methods.name: upsertSyncUserStatus
methods.description: Updates user status, validating remote ID.

methods.name: transformMentionsOnReceive
methods.description: Transforms mentions in received posts using explicit mention mappings.
